Usage:  circleci project list [flags]

Flags:
      --following       only projects you follow (default when no other filter is given)
  -h, --help            help for list
      --jq string       Process values from the response using jq syntax
      --json            Output as JSON
      --name string     only projects matching this name
      --org-id string   only projects in this organization UUID
      --slug string     resolve one project by slug (e.g. gh/myorg/myrepo)
